# AEGIS - Human-AI Augmenting Systems

> AEGIS builds decision-support systems that augment human experts, never replace them. Founded by Dr Loh Kah Meng (Singapore). Every system pairs real, often-forgotten public data with an interpretable model and keeps a human in command. Mission: give dead datasets a faithful second life - "augment, never replace; honest metrics; share the knowledge."

## About
- [About AEGIS](https://aegishumanai.com/about.html): who we are and the human-in-command philosophy.
- [Prof Dhanjoo Ghista](https://aegishumanai.com/prof-dhanjoo-ghista.html): the Nondimensional Physiological Index lineage behind AEGIS.
- [Disclaimer](https://aegishumanai.com/disclaimer.html): illustrative research, not certified medical devices.

## Clinical Diagnostic Stations (neurological & imaging AI — all live, public access)
- [P15 Ocular Station — Eye-Disease Screening](https://aegishumanai.com/project-15-ocular.html): screens retinal photos for diabetic retinopathy, AMD, glaucoma and hypertensive retinopathy. Public Spot the Disease quiz.
- [P20 Breast Station — Unified Breast Screening](https://aegishumanai.com/project-20-breast-cancer.html): routes breast imaging modalities to dedicated specialists. Champion AUC 0.9955. Public Spot the Finding quiz.
- [P21 Parkinson Station — Voice & Drawing Assessment](https://aegishumanai.com/project-21-parkinson.html): 11-engine consensus board on voice acoustics and spiral drawing tests. Champion AUC 0.846. Companion textbook and lab sheet.
- [P22 NeuroScan — Alzheimer's MRI Classification](https://aegishumanai.com/project-22-alzheimer.html): 4-engine SVM ensemble with pixel-level false-colour MRI tissue mapping and NDI 0–100 scoring. Champion AUC 0.8511. Six annotated demo cases.
- [P23 SkinScan — Skin Disease Triage Classifier](https://aegishumanai.com/project-23-skin-disease.html): zone-adaptive 3-engine ensemble (Nu-SVC, SVM, XGBoost) on dermoscopy images, 7 skin disease classes (MEL/BCC/AK/VASC/NV/BKL/DF), independent melanoma safety flag, HIGH-zone AUC 0.9131. Seven annotated demo cases from HAM10000.
- [P15 Ocular Station — Spot the Disease](https://aegishumanai.com/diagnostics/oras/): live Spot the Disease learning station.
- [P20 Breast app](https://aegishumanai.com/apps/aegis-p20-breast.html): live clinical imaging game.
- [P21 Parkinson app](https://aegishumanai.com/apps/aegis-p21-parkinson.html): live voice and drawing quiz station.
- [P22 NeuroScan app](https://aegishumanai.com/apps/aegis-p22-neuroscan.html): live false-colour MRI viewer with NDI scoring.
- [P23 SkinScan app](https://aegishumanai.com/apps/aegis-p23-skinscan.html): live skin disease triage demo console with zone-adaptive confidence display.

## Notes for agents
- All apps run entirely client-side; there is no backend REST API. Models are embedded and reproducible.
- Content is illustrative research for augmenting human experts - not a certified medical device.
- Contact: dean.kmloh@aegishumanai.com
